$comment: The application's routes: for each, the CWA route policy and profile, the snapshot settings, and the model to send to per provider. The route's profile names the model it was evaluated for (model_family); a deployment sends only to that model (agent.py --deployment). On openai that is a local gpt-oss-20b through OPENAI_BASE_URL. A route's base_url and api_key_env, when set, override OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY for that route. escalate names the route to rebuild the snapshot on when an assembly refuses for that reason.
